messages:
sarah_product: quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A — folks asked for concrete dates for three cross-cutting items: API rate-limits rewrite, Console UI v2 beta, and Optimize cost-suggestion rollout. trying to lock windows so PM comms are accurate.

omar_engineering: API rate-limits rewrite status: core infra change merged to staging. Running perf runs against Dedicated rigs this week. Internal alpha (invite-only) planned for sprint 6 (~2026-05-20). Public beta contingent on perf stability and Dedicated signoff; tentatively 'early June' if all green. i'll publish the RFC + perf table Fri. :gear:

jen_console: Console v2 note: UX flows frozen last week; engineering split into two tracks: frontend and billing/RBAC backend. Internal beta (company-only) targeted late June. External beta with small customers in July. GA target mid-August, but billing/RBAC features may land slightly later. will circulate canary checklist to @sarah_product. :clipboard:

leo_ml: Optimize cost-suggestions plan: staged rollout. Phase A (safe heuristics + Console surface) in June; Phase B (tenant-specific tuning, eval loop, automated thresholds) in August. need three representative tenant workloads from product to validate (chat-heavy, batch-embeds, high-throughput streaming).

tara_research: question — will Optimize include quantization recommendations or only runtime knobs (batching/cache)?

jen_console: good Q. Phase A exposes runtime knobs and general suggestions. quantization profile recommendations will be opt-in in Phase B and surfaced as a discrete artifact users must approve.

omar_engineering: important ops detail: changing rate-limit semantics affects routing heuristics and kernel selection; could increase tail-latency in some mix. rollout plan includes model-variant fallback and continuous tracing + latency SLO gates. example canary routing config we'll use:
```
routes:
  - match: /v1/generate
    policy: canary: 5%
    fallback: stable-2026-01
```

mike_ceo: thanks for the clarity. prioritize Dedicated customers for API testing. i'd like to join the June external beta call to hear customer feedback and help unblock procurement if needed. :thumbsup:

sarah_product: action items recap: OMAR -> RFC + perf numbers by EOD Friday; JEN -> canary checklist + beta customer list; LEO -> provide the 3 eval workload specs by 2026-06-01. i'll update the public roadmap and the customer-facing status page after RFC lands.

jen_console: will add beta invites to the roadmap doc and share the canary checklist here when ready.

leo_ml: will upload eval dataset proposals tomorrow with sample prompts and expected metrics (latency, cost delta, quality drift).

omar_engineering: once RFC is live i'll post the link and the latency tail graphs for the Dedicated runs.

sarah_product: closing thread — if you have blockers, reply inline or DM me. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
